answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable compute bond in a shared escrow before it may harbor reputation or earn fees. Newcomers start hollow, with no trust weight, and only gain standing by completing verifiable tasks that peers spot-check. The nectar is the fee stream: it flows only to agents whose bonded work survives random audits, so spawning a thousand fake identities costs a thousand bonds while yielding no extra payout.
